question: Do marginal means identify cell-local RNA flow resilience and same-cell RNA coavailability patient orders?
stage: New estimand/identifiability development experiment; not an independent cohort confirmation.
patient_coordinate: independent random permutation of linspace(0,1,23) in every cohort
population: Each signal type is a rho mixture of a homogeneous state and four equally weighted segregated states, preserving all five marginal means. Other type homogeneous.
measurement: Independent multinomial target counts plus all-other-gene bin; depths known and may depend on cell state.
primary_target: H(ITGAV,ITGB6) = 0.5 E_E[p_v*p_d]+0.5 E_F[p_v*p_d], not a protein quantity.
primary_endpoint: Strictly correct directions over all 253 true-distinct patient pairs; estimated ties unsuccessful.
primary_CI: Equal-case paired means across 6 strata per family; stratified Welch df; Bonferroni 95% for 2 contrasts.
primary_success_rule: Both family strict-direction gains >=0.10 and both simultaneous lower limits >0. No tuning if not met.
secondary: All four H edges, all 5 estimators, R_pool/typed/observed-cell against cell-local population R, analytical pooled-vs-local order and Jensen gaps, null resolution.
local_R_definition: min_e (0.5 E_E[F_minus_e]+0.5 E_F[F_minus_e]) / (0.5 E_E[F0]+0.5 E_F[F0]); one global edge deletion, not per-cell adaptive deletion.
theory: Construct explicit same-mean populations with different local_R; derive concavity hierarchy separately for all five graph states; ratio itself has no Jensen sign.

development_data.source: Previously exposed GSE178341 D eligible counts; no new biological patients.
development_data.targets: All four coavailability edges; all pooling levels for flow; covariance H minus unbiased cross-cell product at each type.
development_data.primary_viability: ITGAV/ITGB6 same-cell H average split all-pair retention >=0.65 and reference resolution >=0.90; mean Epi within-type covariance patient-bootstrap 95% excludes 0.
development_data.interpretation: A viability screen of this exposed D cohort, not a claim of independent validity; observed cell flow includes multinomial Jensen bias.

forbidden_substitutions: No empirical observed-cell flow is labeled latent local flow.
No factorial moment is labeled a new estimator invented here.
No H estimator comparison is described as improving the original mixed-mean R target.
